solutions.title: List window sum
solutions.strategy: Keep all values in a list and sum the active suffix for every query.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each next can sum up to k values.

solutions.title: Queue running sum
solutions.strategy: Keep only the active window in a queue and maintain its running sum.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each next does constant queue and sum updates.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue stores at most k values.
